The dominant logo, narrower menu and exploded notebook drawing now match the source's three main visual masses. Both album/help books use the illustrated atlas art; the full page remains visible.
The complete landscape is contained with paper above and below. All actions remain separate and readable, with the profile chip in the upper paper band.
Complete source-aspect landscape, balanced narrower menu, visible pen and all three exploded barrel alternatives. Play remains the dominant action.

scenes.title: Map
improvements: Castle, metrics, objective and inks occupy the sidebar's actual height instead of ending around mid-height at 4:3.
Sidebar text and ink hierarchy are larger at 4:3; all live values remain unchanged.
Native coin has the correct currency meaning, and illustrated album books match the source language.

captures.observation: Final recapture: the complete 'Рисунков в наборе: 8 / 8' fits on one readable line. Castle, four metrics, objective, ink labels and action use the sidebar height. All map well landmarks remain visible; larger landscape paper bands are documented.
All four metric values fit on one line. Castle, objective, three ink bottles and preparation action are clear, with no overlap. The full map illustration remains visible.
Castle and four ruled metric rows read in the source order, followed by the objective and ink bottles. Album books and native coin are visible. The preparation button clears all labels.

Final recapture: 8 waves, castle 250, starting 640 and 8/8 loadout are readable in single rows. All three ink labels and primary action remain clear.

Source-like centered ribbon and four-by-two hierarchy. Larger numbered badges and names, illustrated pencil prices and footer books are clear. Generator retains both lines without colliding with actions.

The existing landscape's castle base sits partly behind the ribbon. Its source artwork has a taller castle than the concept's open scenery strip; this is a decorative asset mismatch, not a hidden gameplay control.
